description: This source file defines the PurgeService class within the OrangeHRM Maintenance plugin. It handles data purging operations for employees and candidates, including interfacing with DAOs, purge strategies, event dispatching, and transaction management. The class includes methods for purging employee data, candidate data, loading purge configurations from YAML files, and dynamically instantiating purge strategies.

classes.name: PurgeService
classes.description: Service class responsible for purging employee and candidate data within the OrangeHRM system, using configurable strategies, event dispatching, and transaction management.

methods.name: getPurgeDao
methods.description: Returns the instance of PurgeDao, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getEmployeePictureService
methods.description: Returns the EmployeePictureService instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: purgeEmployeeData
methods.description: Performs data purge for a specific employee identified by employee number, managing transaction, strategy execution, and event dispatching.

methods.name: purgeCandidateData
methods.description: Performs data purge for a specific candidate identified by vacancy ID, managing transaction and strategy execution.

methods.name: getPurgeableEntities
methods.description: Loads and caches the list of purgeable entities from a YAML configuration file based on the given filename.

methods.name: getPurgeStrategy
methods.description: Dynamically instantiates and returns a purge strategy object based on the class name convention and given info array.
